items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Don Byas only in response to the interviewer's statement about the tune 'White Rose Kick' and the club 'White Rose', confirming the existence of the club/tune but not describing a personal interaction or relationship with Byas himself.

ctx.x: Well, you've done a lot for Chicago, too.

Well, I mean, whatever I did, it wasn't intentional -- I mean, intentionally for the purpose of doing it. I just wanted to do something for the people, because I run into so many beautiful people. Well, like you, Don, I've known you all through the DownBeat years and all of that, and you've always been great.
